answer: Make every identity post a refundable bond that is slashed when peers prove it controls multiple accounts, so a sybil farm must lock real capital behind each clone, like tending every tree in a crowded orchard rather than planting one seed. The failure mode is a wealthy attacker simply affording many bonds, so the check weighs each bond against the identity's earned standing: the network audits the trellis of attestations tying bond to behaviour and revokes any bond whose holder shows no genuine oasis of sustained, independently verified work.
